The AiDEX Continuous Glucose Monitoring System (CGMS) is indicated for continuous or regular monitoring of glucose levels in subcutaneous tissue, and is used for daily detection and self-management of blood glucose levels in people age 14 years and older. It is intended for use by patients at home and in healthcare facilities.
Interpretation of the AiDEX CGMS results should be based on the glucose trends and several sequential readings over time. The AiDEX CGMS also aids in the detection of episodes of hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia. Measurements should not be used to make treatment adjustments, but rather as a reminder of when fingertip testing is required.
